title: Data Centers / Zoning Code / Definition and Regulatory Framework
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Department of City Planning, to report back with recommended amendments to Chapter 1 and Chapter 1 A, and any other relevant sections, to: 1. Create a clear and comprehensive definition of “Data Center” and any related or accessory uses (including but not limited to server farms, cloud computing facilities, cryptocurrency mining operations, and large-scale digital storage facilities); and 2. Establish appropriate use classifications and zoning permissions for Data Centers, including identification of the zones in which such uses are permitted by right, permitted conditionally, or prohibited. I FURTHER MOVE that the report back also includes recommendations for additional measures to better regulate Data Centers in a manner that protects the health and safety of residents and the environment, based on an analysis of best practices from other major jurisdictions. I FURTHER MOVE that the Council request the Department of Water and Power (LADWP) to prepare a standalone assessment of potential impacts Data Centers may have on the City’s power grid, water resources, and climate goals, and policy recommendations to address those impacts. PRESENT / oXron V • MONICA RODRIGUEZ/ — J Councilwoman, 7™ Distrkt 5 SECONDED BY: FEB 2 4 2026
